claim_boundary: Retrospective 27-growth method-development outer LOO from the accepted M20 milestone. Each Sq estimate and morphology-statistic fit excludes the displayed growth. The enlarged second island layer is conditioned on strict outer-LOO predicted Sq, while target-blind RHEED spot isolation controls gap-preferring versus stacked nucleation. No measured query AFM is used. Selection is retrospective and still requires prospective confirmation.

confidence.confidence_definition: Smoothed survival percentile of equal-weight ranks of strictly cross-fitted expected FSMI and island-topology errors. FSMI already contains height amplitude, so Rq is not double-counted.

protocol: retrospective nested leave-one-growth-out over the fixed harmonized 27-growth cohort
